*.on_behalf_of: an argument on agent connections, named in notes about the caller
*.trophy_change: a loss on the arena's trophy floor carries trophy_change null: the note says the game omits the field
*.pre_reset: on a series row only at a season roll
*.pol_trophies: the profile's name for the board's rating, pointed at by rankings notes

elixir_changelog.tools_added: on an entry only when a version added tools

players_names.in_corpus: on unknown[] rows, present only when a tag is unknown

war_current.points_earned: days_closed's per-day fields, absent until a war day closes

docs._: tokens the docs use as prose or as another surface's fields; each with its reason
docs.live_status: rides only on live: true reads, which the suite never makes
docs.observed_ip: operators page: owner-only console fields, never on the MCP surface
docs.filters_applied: documented as a key that does NOT exist
docs.notify_off: an account preference the timeline docs name, not a response field
docs.pol_league: the glossary's name for the profile's league field
docs.towers_before: on a battle row only when the record holds the boat/tower counters for that battle
docs.modal_arena: on trophy_floor only for a player with a floor in the window
docs.last_battle_at: on a `returned` timeline item, a rare kind
docs.player_activity: a timeline entry kind for a player subject; the acceptance principal is a clan agent and follows no player
